title: Binary Search
summary: Find the index of a target in a sorted array of distinct numbers in O(log n) time, or report that it is missing.

tests.explain: 2 would belong between 1 and 3, but it isn't in the array, so the answer is -1.
With one element, the only possible index is 0.

hints: The array is sorted. Looking at one middle element tells you which half the target must be in.
Keep a range [lo, hi] that still might contain the target. Compare nums[mid] with the target and throw away the half that can't contain it.
Loop while lo <= hi (the range is not empty). Move lo to mid + 1 or hi to mid - 1, never to mid itself, or the loop can stall.

complexity.time: O(log n): the range halves on every step
